ModMetaData.name: Recipe & Crafting Tweaker
ModMetaData.author: SadSeal5
ModMetaData.description:
In-game real-time recipe and crafting editor for RimWorld:
Features: - Live Recipe Editor: Search and edit any vanilla or modded recipe on the fly. - Work Amount / Crafting Speed Fix: Synchronizes recipe work amount with item WorkToMake stat. - Custom Ingredient Picker: Swap, add, or adjust material requirements from any installed mod. - Disable Unwanted Recipes: Toggle any recipe on or off with a single checkbox. - 1-Click XML Exporter: Export all custom changes into a clean RimWorld PatchOperation XML file for sharing. - Modern Mod Settings Menu with full English & Turkish translations.
